title: Certificates of Deposit: whether a same-tier renewal earns the Jumbo Bonus
content:
## Scope

This rule applies when a Certificates of Deposit certificate renews into its own tier after the grace period. It decides whether the new term earns the Jumbo Bonus.

## Rule

The Jumbo Bonus is earned on the renewal when both of these hold:

1. the tier offers the Jumbo Bonus; and
2. the certificate's principal on the renewal date is at least the tier's Jumbo threshold.

Where the principal balance recorded on the certificate differs from the principal reconciled from the certificate's own ledger, the reconciled figure governs the Jumbo test.

## Truth table

| Tier offers the Jumbo Bonus | Principal on the renewal date at least the Jumbo threshold | Jumbo Bonus earned on the renewal |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Yes |
| Yes | No | No |
| No | Yes | No |
| No | No | No |

## Boundary cases (illustrative threshold of 80000.00, not a tier value)

| Principal on the renewal date | Earned? |
|---|---|
| 80000.00 | Yes, equal to the threshold is enough |
| 79999.99 | No |
| 80000.01 | Yes |

## Recorded balance against reconciled figure (illustrative threshold of 80000.00)

| Principal balance recorded on the certificate | Principal reconciled from the ledger | Figure used | Earned? |
|---|---|---|---|
| 79990.00 | 80010.00 | 80010.00, the reconciled figure | Yes |
| 80010.00 | 79990.00 | 79990.00, the reconciled figure | No |

## Points of judgement

**The certificate had the Jumbo Bonus in its old term. Does it carry over to the new term?**
Not by itself. Earning it on the renewal depends only on the tier offering it and on the principal on the renewal date reaching the Jumbo threshold.

**The certificate was just under the Jumbo threshold at the old term's start but is above it on the renewal date. Is the Jumbo Bonus earned?**
Yes, provided the tier offers it: the test is made on the principal on the renewal date.
